verdict.rationale: Gemini in Gmail lets users issue natural-language requests to summarize threads, draft/refine emails, and organize (delete, label) messages, which is genuine NL command support (gmail-docs-13,14,23,33). However, this covers only a subset of actions (no evidence of broad NL control over search, filters, delegation, scheduling, etc.), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability. Missing for 10: evidence of NL commands covering the full range of Gmail actions, and independent verification that Gemini's NL organize/draft features work reliably.
